summary: Phase 88 (Course/Job Role Master + WO integration) end-to-end verified. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed covering CRUD (full-field create + default_hours auto-sync), 409 duplicate guards (name + qp_code, on POST and PATCH), PATCH updates with updated_by/updated_at + training_hours<->default_hours sync, DELETE soft-deactivate (204 + active=false), GET filters (q/sector/category/active_only/with_usage), 404 on usage for unknown id, WO integration (course_master_id stored + returned), value math 300*41*20=246000 / PBG 3%=7380 verified, admin override kept, non-admin (manager via hr@finance.app) enforcement: tampered/blank sector/sub_sector/course/qp/category/nsqf/hours/cost overwritten from master while beneficiaries preserved -> WO value recomputed to 246000/PBG 7380, and WO without course_master_id still works (100000/3000). Frontend: /course-master page renders with all filters + Add button; created a TEST_UI course, edited cost 41->45, deactivate/reactivate toggle works. New Work Order modal (bm-tgt-add-wo-btn): course combobox loaded 2 items on 'TEST_UI_' search, '+ Add New Course' opens the shared CourseMasterFormDialog inline, saving auto-selects the new course into the row and shows 'Mapped from Course Master' lock indicator, auto-populated Sector/SubSector/QP/Cat/NSQF/Hours/Cost as expected, saving created WO (300*45*20=270000, PBG 3%=8100, both shown in Financial Summary row). Cleanup: 3 test course masters deactivated + 1 test WO deleted (no leftover dummy rows).

issues: React dev-mode 'Uncaught runtime errors: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' error overlay appears when the WO modal opens (bundle.js handleError). Non-blocking (does not affect functionality - WO saved fine and math computed correctly) but the red overlay is noisy in preview. Typically caused by shadcn Popover/Command resizing inside the modal. Consider wrapping window.addEventListener('error', suppressResizeObserver) or ignoring these in the errorOverlay config.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Silence the ResizeObserver loop error overlay in dev/preview builds — appears whenever the WO course combobox/popover opens inside the modal. Functionality is intact; only the red overlay is cosmetic noise.
